tenders.title: Carrying out digital survey, digital mapping & ground penetration radar (GPR) survey and providing drawings of the built-up properties and open area including details of underground utility services of various Sports Complexes/Golf Courses under sports zone (Specialized work)
tenders.scope_summary: This tender involves conducting digital survey, digital mapping, and GPR survey for sports complexes and golf courses. The scope includes providing drawings of built-up properties and open areas, with detailed information on underground utility services.
key_points: Digital survey and mapping of sports complexes and golf courses.
Provision of drawings for built-up properties and open areas.
Detailed mapping of underground utility services.

tenders.title: Supply of LIDAR - 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per MHA QRS
